review_request.title: feat(gcw): add hosted GitHub Actions workflows for steps 2-9
review_request.summary: Adds hosted GitHub Actions entrypoints for GCW milestones 2–9: shared `gcw-setup` composite action, `prepare_gcw_hosted_step.py` phase gate, eight `gcw-*.yml` workflows (triage through pr-review), and YAML validation tests. Mutating steps delegate to existing `run_gcw_step.py` / `manage_gcw_workflow.py`; gate steps run `validate_gcw_evidence.py`.

risks: Workflow files that modify `.github/workflows/` may require elevated token permissions in consumer repos; `gcw-implement-check` and `gcw-pr-publish` expect a pre-built payload file / PR URL at dispatch time.
scope: Hosted automation only; does not embed in-runner LLM agents. Docs update (workflow.md / quickstart.md) deferred to a follow-up within the issue spec.
reviewer_notes: Verify `dry_run` paths on each workflow and confirm phase gating via `prepare_gcw_hosted_step.py` matches `workflow.json` phases.
